# Domain-specialised market makers (generated by market/makers.py; do not edit by hand)

Real Kalshi taker trades replayed against LMSR makers opened at the noon cutoff on D-1. Train 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-31, test to 2026-08-13; 6 cities. Daily PnL in dollars for one six-bin event. A counterfactual estimate, not realized PnL.

## 1. What each idea adds (same settings for every maker)

Every maker uses the forecast maker's train-day b0 and fee in each city (kappa 0.3 for the throttle), so a difference comes from the idea alone. Mean test-day PnL gain per city; pooled = each city's daily gaps divided by their own standard deviation, then all city-days resampled.

## Caveats

- Replay: a real trade fills only if the maker would have been at least as good, at the taker's own price. Trades the maker would have attracted but Kalshi did not are missing, and traders might have reacted to these quotes.
- The live makers act on the 1-minute reading from 5 minutes earlier, as a stand-in for the public 5-minute feed; a faster feed would do better, a slower one worse.
- Two months of train days choose 12 to 24 settings per maker; per-maker tuning overfits (see the throttle), which is why the same-settings table leads.
- The Kalshi references copy the crowd's noon prices; they bound what a forecast prior could achieve, they are not a domain model.
